launchScope: Free text curriculum, training applications and project enquiries only. No booking, paid enrolment, payment, referral credit, uploads or learner accounts.

requestRules.encoding: Strict UTF-8; reject malformed encoding, unpaired surrogates and control characters except tab/newline/carriage return in multiline fields.
requestRules.stringLengths: Unicode code points after trimming surrounding whitespace; no Unicode normalization
requestRules.origin: Required for public writes: https://learnatbillioncodes.com or https://www.learnatbillioncodes.com. Additional local origins only when explicitly configured by operator.
requestRules.idempotency: Required Idempotency-Key: RFC 4122/9562 UUID, version 1-8 and variant 8/9/a/b. Reuse for unchanged retry. Canonical validated payload and endpoint scope are compared; same key with different payload or endpoint returns 409. Accepted retries return original 201 and id.
requestRules.consent: Must be boolean true. Consent is to storing these details for reviewing and responding to this enquiry, not marketing.
requestRules.website: Optional honeypot string. Must be empty or whitespace; nonempty rejected with 422. Do not show to real users.

email.format: practical ASCII email, local part <=64; no whitespace; domain must have a dot

targetDate.note: Preference only; no deadline or availability commitment.

GET /api/health.note: 503 if D1 schema or SECURITY_SALT missing; health does not expose private values.

GET /api/v1/admin/submissions.authorization: Bearer ADMIN_TOKEN or staff Firebase ID token; role reviewer or owner

PATCH /api/v1/admin/submissions/{id}.authorization: Bearer ADMIN_TOKEN or staff Firebase ID token; role reviewer or owner
PATCH /api/v1/admin/submissions/{id}.note: 409 on stale version. Same status is a no-op. Status changes are atomically audited; no deletion endpoint.

GET /api/v1/admin/submissions/{id}/audit.authorization: Bearer ADMIN_TOKEN or staff Firebase ID token; role reviewer or owner
GET /api/v1/admin/submissions/{id}/audit.note: Last 100 changes; no body, token or IP in audit.

GET /api/v1/admin/me.authorization: Bearer ADMIN_TOKEN (owner bootstrap) or Bearer Firebase ID token of a verified email with an active staff grant
GET /api/v1/admin/me.note: 401 without valid credentials; 403 when a verified account has no active staff grant. There is no staff self-registration.

GET /api/v1/admin/staff.authorization: Bearer ADMIN_TOKEN or staff Firebase ID token; role owner

POST /api/v1/admin/staff.authorization: Bearer ADMIN_TOKEN or staff Firebase ID token; role owner
POST /api/v1/admin/staff.note: 409 if the email already has active access or is the caller's own. Re-granting a revoked email reactivates it and clears the previous Firebase account link.

PATCH /api/v1/admin/staff/{id}.authorization: Bearer ADMIN_TOKEN or staff Firebase ID token; role owner
PATCH /api/v1/admin/staff/{id}.note: 409 on stale version, revoked member or own record.

POST /api/v1/admin/staff/{id}/revoke.authorization: Bearer ADMIN_TOKEN or staff Firebase ID token; role owner
POST /api/v1/admin/staff/{id}/revoke.note: Effective on the member's next request. 409 on stale version, already revoked or own record.

/api/v1/payments/*, /api/v1/checkout, /a.error: Payments, paid enrolments and referral credits are not configured.

POST /api/v1/arcade/runs.note: Opens a server-timed Debug Defender run. Origin required. Rate limited to 40 runs per connection per 10 minutes and 50,000 per day; 429 with Retry-After. Stores only an HMAC of day+IP, never the raw address. Runs expire after 3 hours.

POST /api/v1/arcade/scores.note: name: 2-16 letters, numbers, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores; offensive names rejected (400 with fields.name). 404 unknown/expired run, 409 already submitted, 422 when the score is not a multiple of 10, exceeds the most the game allows by that wave, or arrives faster than that wave can be reached. Unknown fields rejected.

GET /api/v1/arcade/leaderboard.note: Top 10 visible entries, ties broken by earliest submission.

shape.fields: optional object mapping field names to messages

statuses.403: Origin or browser request rejected, or staff role does not allow this area
statuses.429: Rate or daily capacity limit; inspect Retry-After
statuses.503: Required service or secrets not configured/unavailable

privacy.publicReads: Only catalog and health; no public submission lookup
privacy.stored: Validated enquiry, consent version/time, payload digest, UUID idempotency key, status and audit. IP is never stored raw; rotating daily HMAC identifiers in expiring rate buckets only.
privacy.adminToken: Header only, browser memory only. Never URL/cookie/localStorage/sessionStorage.

clientNotes: An accepted submission is an enquiry, not a confirmed place, contract, reply promise or payment.
Do not execute or render lesson/submission strings as HTML.
Do not embed an administrator token in any public client.
Native application implementation, user identity and progress sync are deferred; v1 catalog is reusable now.
